name: Siwweschroom
description: Siwweschroom is an Eifel and Rhineland variant of Toepen, a no-trump last-trick game played with four-card hands and aggressive knocking. Players who accumulate seven penalty points are eliminated; the last remaining player wins.

content.text: Siwweschroom is an Eifel and Rhineland variant of Toepen, a no-trump last-trick game played with four-card hands and aggressive knocking. Players who accumulate seven penalty points are eliminated; the last remaining player wins.
Siwweschroom is documented as a local West German form of Dutch Toepen, especially in the Eifel region and parts of the Rhineland.
3-8 players in clockwise order. Dealer rotates each hand.
32-card pack. Rank in every suit is 10 (high), 9, 8, 7, A, K, Q, J (low). There are no trumps.
Cards plus a score track for penalty points.
Deal 4 cards to each player. Leader is player to dealer's left.

items.text: Fast Folding Response: After a knock, players effectively decide immediately and simultaneously whether to fold or stay.
Ordered Folding Response: After a knock, responses proceed in turn starting left of the knocker.
Toepen-Style End: Play to a fixed loser at 10 lives instead of elimination at 7.
